scope: Fixed finite noiseless permutation-control model. Every mathematical result inherits the explicit contract and proof in RESEARCH_CHECKPOINT.md. Actual and named experiential applications require independent justification.

node_defaults.actuality: Finite-model statement unless explicitly marked OPEN_BRIDGE; not empirical proof of C1 or any named feeling.

binding_policy: All premises within a rule are jointly required at the same declared model, prior, goal and policy contract. Separate routes remain OR. Explicit n=4 or selected-family corollaries instantiate universal source results; their assumptions cannot be imported into arbitrary n. Context links are never deductive.

nodes.statement: n>=2 command/effect ports, fixed unknown bijection pi; observed y=P_pi u and x_next=x XOR y. Noiseless known update, legal probes and one terminal command without extra test-time evidence.
nodes.limits: Known generic law is not known actual wiring; no actual-token admission supplied.

nodes.statement: pi is uniform on S_n. Adaptive probe choices depend only on previous observations and independent randomness, whose seed is conditioned upon. Later goals are independent of pi.
nodes.limits: Nonuniform priors, hidden correlated seeds or changing pi are outside probability formulas.

nodes.statement: c_i is the k-bit command history; d_j the observed effect history. Equal-signature classes A_c,B_c have equal size m_c in a feasible transcript.
nodes.limits: Value equality is not physical occurrence identity.

nodes.statement: Compatible adaptive-transcript wirings are exactly independent bijections A_c->B_c, with cardinality product_c m_c! and a uniform posterior under PRIOR.
nodes.limits: Same policy/seed and full feasible transcript are required.

nodes.statement: For specified binary goal g, r_c counts requested ones in B_c. The fixed decoder may select any terminal command from the transcript and g only.
nodes.limits: Success is exact effect change, not a selected experience.

nodes.statement: p*(g|h)=product_c 1/binomial(m_c,r_c); a fixed choice of an r_c-subset in each A_c attains this Bayes optimum.
nodes.limits: Requires the declared posterior and no side information.

nodes.statement: Singleton battery is uniform on n one-hot goals; full-pattern battery uniform on 2^n binary goals. All-on/off are separate explicitly specified goals.
nodes.limits: Task weighting is part of the evaluation contract.

nodes.statement: J_single=c/n for c used signatures; J_pattern=product_c(m_c+1)/2^n. All-on/off succeeds without calibration.
nodes.limits: Collective success does not identify individually localized control.

nodes.statement: Each of k calibration rounds may activate any port subset; all effect changes are observed. Additional physical costs are excluded only in this model.
nodes.limits: Not automatically an admissible human intervention schedule.

nodes.statement: max J_single=min(2^k,n)/n; exact pi recovery needs ceil(log2 n) rounds. For c=min(2^k,n), q=floor(n/c), r=n-cq, max J_pattern=(q+2)^r(q+1)^(c-r)/2^n.
nodes.limits: Coding principle is prior art; a changed k is a changed resource contract.

nodes.statement: At most one command port is activated per round; fixed bijection and full effect observation still hold.
nodes.limits: Alternative probe contract, not a hidden condition on unrestricted parallel results.

nodes.statement: Exact pi recovery under SERIAL needs and can attain n-1 rounds, testing n-1 distinct ports and inferring the last from bijectivity.
nodes.limits: The final connection is inferred under an assumption, not directly observed.

nodes.statement: n=4: none or 1111/1111 leaves 24 mappings and singleton success 1/4; 0011/0011 leaves four and 1/2; 0011/0101 leaves one and success one. The latter pair has equal round and activation counts.
nodes.limits: Installed schedules differ; equal unrestricted optimization permissions can erase this capability difference.

nodes.statement: Fixed goal family G; wiring-dependent state m(pi) supplies a fixed decoder d(m,g) that succeeds for every pi,g without other pi-information. All accessible wiring-correlated hardware, weights and records count.
nodes.limits: Full pi may be learned before encoding; no uniform prior is needed for the zero-error worst-case claim.

nodes.statement: pi~_G pi' iff inverse actions agree for every goal in G. Effect ports with identical goal-incidence coordinates form classes of sizes b_l.
nodes.limits: Task-equivalence is not complete physical or phenomenal equivalence.

nodes.statement: M_min(G)=n!/product_l b_l! distinct wiring-dependent states are necessary and sufficient for zero-error control.
nodes.limits: Factorization and stabilizer counting are inherited mathematics; exact-package priority unverified.

nodes.statement: n=4: all-on/off needs 1 state, one fixed singleton 4, any singleton 24 (at least five fixed-length bits). r designated singletons need n!/(n-r)!; one r-element pattern needs binomial(n,r).
nodes.limits: Rounds and information-state counts are different resources; neither counts subjects or experience.

nodes.statement: Transport command labels by alpha, effect labels by beta, pi to beta*pi*alpha^-1 and commands/goals/observations consistently.
nodes.limits: Actual rewiring with an unchanged decoder is not passive recoding.

nodes.statement: P_(beta*pi*alpha^-1)P_alpha u=P_beta P_pi u; signature and task-equivalence laws are invariant under the complete transported description.
nodes.limits: Invariant representation does not prove ontic completeness.

nodes.statement: Independently admit actual compared tokens, common complete K/time/boundary, grounded ports/occurrences, installed observation/calibration/use, and faithful agreement of modeled and actual task laws.
nodes.limits: Finite-model enumeration does not discharge real-brain or deployed-AI application.

nodes.statement: A genuine inequality of the same actual capability J is established, including identical declared policy permissions, resource/time scope and goals.
nodes.limits: Different k budgets or poor individual executions cannot replace this premise.

nodes.statement: Under REALIZATION and FIXED_J_DIFFERENCE, inherited C:P1 under C1 gives distinct complete experiential structural types.
nodes.limits: No named quality, pain, fear, richness amount, anatomical owner or current-assistant verdict follows.

nodes.statement: The local actual process persists through the specified coupling or reader alteration under original UCT I P3 criteria.
nodes.limits: Persistence does not imply unchanged detailed organization.

nodes.statement: A persisting actual local process remains under U1 even if another process cannot identify or use its action relation.
nodes.limits: No calibration, control, report or whole-formation experience gate.

nodes.statement: Control can concern external tools and requires no linguistic self sentence in this construction. The results do not establish anatomical ownership, phenomenal mineness or unique subjecthood.
nodes.limits: The remaining feeling bridge does not block other positive organization results.

nodes.statement: A nonuniform prior can outperform the uniform uncalibrated bound; changing pi invalidates a learned decoder; extra feedback/storage changes the one-shot/memory contract.
nodes.limits: Explicit domain failures, not excuses for adapting definitions to every observation.
